interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Bao:[/b][/color] [b]Ten mint candies[/b], please. Like last time.
[color=#ffffff][b]Bao:[/b][/color] Binh was sitting by the drain this morning, before he went to Hanh. He waved and told me he was waiting to speak to her.
[color=#ffffff][b]Bao:[/b][/color] I will get him [b]ten[/b] this time. Maybe he did not like sharing.
[color=#ffffff][b]Bao:[/b][/color] If he comes here, tell him I remembered his five from yesterday.
